clinic.name: Harmony Health Clinic
clinic.address: 742 Evergreen Medical Plaza, Suite 300, Springfield, IL 62704

aiReceptionist.welcomeMessage: Hello! I am your MediFlow AI assistant for Harmony Health Clinic. How can I help you today?
aiReceptionist.escalationThreshold: Medical advice, emergencies, complex billing disputes, or unresolvable slot requests
aiReceptionist.clinicBio: Harmony Health Clinic is a multi-specialty outpatient healthcare facility offering compassionate primary care, pediatrics, dermatology, cardiology consultations, and diagnostic wellness checkups.

services.name: General Health Consultation
services.description: Comprehensive physical assessment, vitals check, chronic care review, and primary care medical guidance.

services.name: Annual Preventive Wellness Exam
services.description: Full body routine health screening, routine bloodwork order, lifestyle counseling, and preventive risk analysis.

services.name: Dermatology Skin Evaluation
services.description: Full dermoscopic skin check, mole screening, acne management, and eczema diagnosis.

services.name: Cardiology Assessment & ECG Review
services.description: Cardiovascular risk evaluation, 12-lead ECG tracing review, blood pressure optimization, and arrhythmia follow-up.

services.name: Pediatric Well-Child Checkup
services.description: Growth and milestone development assessment, immunization scheduling, vision/hearing check for infants and children.

services.name: Chronic Disease Follow-up
services.description: Follow-up for hypertension, diabetes type 2, asthma, or thyroid conditions with lab reviews.

services.name: Minor Skin Lesion Cryotherapy
services.description: Targeted liquid nitrogen cryosurgery for benign warts, seborrheic keratoses, and actinic keratoses.

services.name: Flu & Travel Vaccination Visit
services.description: Seasonal influenza vaccine administration or international travel immunization consultation and record issuance.

automations.name: Appointment Request Processing
automations.description: Automatically validates requested doctor slot availability, validates patient contact, checks for calendar collisions, creates pending record, and queues staff notification.
actions: Validate schedule availability & doctor roster
Verify conflict-free calendar slot
Generate unique booking reference (MF-XXXXX)
Send automated confirmation / pending notice to patient

automations.name: Smart Appointment Reminders
automations.description: Identifies appointments scheduled within 24 hours, drafts personalized pre-visit instructions and time reminders, and marks delivery status.
actions: Scan upcoming appointments within 24-hour window
Compose patient reminder with room number & doctor name
Attach fasting or clinical prep guidelines if applicable
Record delivery timestamp in audit trail

automations.name: Inquiry Classification & Routing
automations.description: Uses Google Gemini to analyze patient message semantics, categorize the topic, evaluate urgency/priority, and automatically route urgent or medical issues to clinical staff.
automations.trigger: New incoming inquiry or chat escalation
actions: Analyze incoming text with Gemini classifier
Assign 1 of 6 official inquiry categories
Tag priority level (low, medium, high, urgent)
Route emergency/clinical questions to nurse triage queue

automations.name: Daily Clinic Operations Summary
automations.description: Aggregates daily booking volume, cancellation metrics, doctor utilization, and outstanding inquiries into a concise administrative briefing for clinic management.
actions: Aggregate appointment count, completions, no-shows
Calculate clinic cancellation & conversion rates
Summarize open inquiries requiring receptionist attention
Generate executive narrative with Gemini

automations.name: Missed Appointment Follow-up
automations.description: Detects when an appointment is marked as No-show, drafts a compassionate follow-up message with rebooking links, and queues it for receptionist review.
actions: Detect No-show status trigger
Create administrative follow-up task for receptionist
Draft polite check-in message with available rebooking slots
Require receptionist review before sending
